lo-how-a-rose-eer-bloomi.lyrics:
[00:01.60]Lo, how a rose e'er blooming,
[00:07.54]From tender stem hath sprung.
[00:18.46]Of Jesse's lineage coming,
[00:25.40]As men of old have sung;
[00:32.92]It came, a flow'ret bright,
[00:41.86]Amid the cold of winter,
[00:49.20]When half spent was the night

[01:01.10]Isaiah 'twas foretold it,
[01:09.36]The Rose I have in mind,
[01:19.14]With Mary we behold it,
[01:27.74]The virgin mother kind;
[01:37.26]To show God's love aright,
[01:43.96]She bore to men a Savior,
[01:49.28]When half spent was the night.

joy-to-the-world.lyrics:
[00:01.00]Joy to the world! The Lord is come!
[00:05.04]Let earth receive her King;
[00:08.70]Let every heart prepare Him room,
[00:13.28]And heaven and nature sing,
[00:15.36]And heaven and nature sing,
[00:17.20]And heaven, and heaven, and nature sing.

[00:22.24]Joy to the Earth! The Savior reigns!
[00:26.20]Let men their songs employ;
[00:29.94]While fields and floods, rocks, hills and plains
[00:34.20]Repeat the sounding joy,
[00:35.94]Repeat the sounding joy,
[00:38.60]Repeat, repeat, the sounding joy.

[00:42.44]He rules the world with truth and grace,
[00:46.38]And makes the nations prove
[00:49.96]The glories of His righteousness,
[00:55.56]And wonders of His love,
[00:57.26]And wonders of His love,
[00:59.20]And wonders, wonders, of His love.

good-king-wenceslas.lyrics:
[00:00.80]Good King Wenceslas look'd out, On the Feast of Stephen;
[00:05.66]When the snow lay round about, Deep, and crisp, and even:
[00:10.28]Brightly shone the moon that night, Though the frost was cruel,
[00:15.10]When a poor man came in sight, Gath'ring winter fuel.

[00:22.50]"Bring me flesh, and bring me wine, Bring me pine logs hither:
[00:27.64]"Thou and I will see him dine, When we bear them thither."
[00:32.36]Page and monarch forth they went, Forth they went together:
[00:37.06]Through the rude wind's wild lament And the bitter weather.

[00:44.70]In his master's steps he trod, Where the snow lay dinted;
[00:49.28]Heat was in the very sod Which the Saint had printed.
[00:53.80]Therefore, Christian men, be sure, Wealth or rank possessing,
[00:59.10]Ye who now will bless the poor, Shall yourselves find blessing.

hark-the-herald-angels-s.lyrics:
[00:00.90]Hark! the herald angels sing
[00:05.84]Glory to the new-born King!
[00:10.62]Peace on earth and mercy mild,
[00:15.20]God and sinners reconciled.
[00:19.32]Joyful all ye nations rise,
[00:25.32]Join the triumph of the skies,
[00:30.24]With the angelic host proclaim
[00:35.20]Christ is born in Bethlehem!
[00:40.30]Hark! the herald angels sing
[00:44.84]Glory to the new-born King!

[00:52.12]Hail the heaven-born Prince of Peace!
[00:57.24]Hail the Sun of Righteousness!
[01:02.40]Light and life to all he brings,
[01:07.60]Risen with healing in his wings.
[01:12.68]Mild, he lays his glory by;
[01:16.98]Born, that man no more may die,
[01:22.76]Born to raise the sons of earth,
[01:27.52]Born to give them second birth.
[01:32.92]Hark! the herald angels sing
[01:37.68]Glory to the new-born King!

angels-we-have-heard-on.lyrics:

[00:04.76]Sweetly singing o'er the plains
[00:09.32]And the mountains in reply
[00:13.48]Echoing their joyous strains
[00:19.58]Gloria in excelsis Deo!
